newsitem.title: UK: Four EU green rates to devalue on Thursday-HGCA.
newsitem.headline: Four EU green rates to devalue on Thursday-HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, German mark, Dutch guilder and Austrian schilling will be devalued with effect from Thursday, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) said.
The changes were a result of the relative strength of the Finnish mark.
They come hot on the heels of a round of changes on Tuesday.

The new rates are as 40.3103 per ECU for the Belgian franc, compared with the previous rate of 40.2147, 1.95540 for the German mark, compared with 1.95076, 2.19663 for the Dutch guilder, compared with 2.19067 and 13.7562 for the Austrian Schilling, compared with 13.7246.
The rates are used by the European Union (EU) to convert Ecu into the currencies of its member stats in its Common Agricultural Policy.
